segments.sub: OF BLACK FRIDAY DEALS WERE CHEAPER ON THE DAY
segments.text: Only twenty-two percent of Black Friday deals were actually cheaper on the day. Here are three signs a deal is fake.
One. A huge crossed-out was price. Check the price history first. It's often been that low before.
Two. A countdown timer rushing you. In India, false urgency is one of the banned dark patterns.
Three. The price jumps at checkout. That's drip pricing, and it's on India's banned list too.

segments.sub: 'IN THE BLACK' ISN'T WHERE THE NAME CAME FROM
segments.text: And no, the name has nothing to do with shops going into the black. The real story, and all five tricks, are in our full video.
